comment: Caption word folding, shared by the web preview (captionPreview.ts bareToken / accentWordIndices, captions.ts stripPunctuation) and the export (captions.py _bare_token / _accent_indices). Both test suites assert these exact outputs, so the two renderers accent the same words. Fold: NFKC, lowercase, keep Unicode letters (L), combining marks (M) and numbers (N). Marks matter for Devanagari, whose vowel signs and virama are marks.

accent.name: a Devanagari keyword accents the word, final vowel sign included
words that differ only in their vowel sign stay different words
a Devanagari phrase accents its whole run
a keyword truncated by the old fold no longer matches the full word
precomposed and decomposed spellings match each other
Latin phrases still match case- and punctuation-insensitively
